The API SLA risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted risk assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.76 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.57s. While the logic is reusable, the discrepancy between the perfect verifier score and the lower judge reward suggests potential for optimization in code style or edge-case handling.
